function.name: confirm_contact
function.description: Record the caller's yes or no to the read-back of their contact details. Call it right after they answer, with no words of your own, not even an acknowledgement: its result sentence acknowledges them (rule 2: already spoken, or read out word for word when spoken is false).

correct.description: true when the caller said the details read back are right; false when they said something is wrong.

messages.content: Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
I'm sorry, I couldn't save that just now. I can have someone from our claims team call you back instead. Would you like that?
